name: Shu'bah ibn al-Hajjaj
nameAr: شعبة بن الحجاج بن الورد العتكي مولاهم، أبو بسطام، الواسطي ثم البصري
bornNote: 82 or 83 AH, at Nahrayan below Wasit (Ibn Hibban, al-Thiqat, as given on the Shamela record)

taqrib.ar: ثقة حافظ متقن، كان الثوري يقول: هو أمير المؤمنين في الحديث، وهو أول من فتش بالعراق عن الرجال وذب عن السنة، وكان عابدا
taqrib.en: Reliable, a hadith master, precise. Al-Thawri used to say he was the Commander of the Faithful in hadith. He was the first in Iraq to investigate the narrators and to defend the Sunnah, and he was devout.

role: Founder of narrator criticism in Iraq

teachers.name: Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid
teachers.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 4387 (Shu'bah, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid)

students.name: Sulayman ibn Harb
students.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 2810 (the shorter route of the “word of Allah” hadith)

students.name: Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan
students.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 13 (Musaddad, from Yahya, from Shu'bah)

verdicts.en: He is the Commander of the Faithful in hadith.

verdicts.ar: كان شعبة أمة وحده في هذا الشأن، يعني في الرجال وبصره بالحديث وتثبته وتنقيته للرجال
verdicts.en: Shu'bah was a nation unto himself in this matter, meaning in the narrators, his insight into hadith, his verification and his sifting of men.

verdicts.ar: أثبت أصحاب أبي إسحاق: الثوري وشعبة وإسرائيل، وشعبة أحب إلي من إسرائيل
verdicts.en: The firmest of Abu Ishaq's students are al-Thawri, Shu'bah and Isra'il, and Shu'bah is dearer to me than Isra'il.

verdicts.ar: كان من سادات أهل زمانه حفظا وإتقانا وورعا وفضلا، وهو أول من فتش بالعراق عن أمر المحدثين وجانب الضعفاء والمتروكين
verdicts.en: One of the masters of his age in memory, precision, scrupulousness and virtue; the first in Iraq to investigate the affairs of narrators and to shun the weak and the abandoned.
verdicts.source: al-Thiqat, as quoted in Ikmal Tahdhib al-Kamal 6/256

dhahabi.ar: أمير المؤمنين في الحديث، ثبت حجة، ويخطئ في الأسماء قليلا
dhahabi.en: Commander of the Faithful in hadith, firm, a proof; he erred a little in names.

flags.label: His “from” over Qatadah counts as hearing
flags.detail: Shu'bah said: “I have spared you the tadlis of three: al-A'mash, Abu Ishaq and Qatadah.” Ibn Hajar draws the rule that a report from these three through Shu'bah indicates hearing even when phrased “from” (Tabaqat al-Mudallisin, closing section). This is why Qatadah's “from Anas” in the second chain of hadith 15 raises no question.

bio: Born near Wasit and settled in Basra, Shu'bah was the first scholar of Iraq to examine narrators systematically, and the critics of the next century treated his judgements as foundational. Al-Thawri called him the Commander of the Faithful in hadith and Ahmad “a nation unto himself” in the knowledge of men. He appears here twice: as Ghundar's shaykh in hadith 3126 and as Adam's shaykh in the second chain of hadith 15, where his known care over Qatadah's transmission matters.

provenance.ref: Ibn Hibban, al-Thiqat, via Ikmal Tahdhib al-Kamal (Shamela record)

sources.label: Ibn Hajar, Tabaqat al-Mudallisin, closing section on Shu'bah's rule (Shamela)
